blurb: Guests can enjoy various sailboat cruises on Chesapeake Bay including private cruises, themed and special cruises, sunset cruises, and dock party cruises. Cruises accommodate small groups and offer different pricing for adults, seniors, and children. The cruises are offered at different times including 6 PM for sunset options.
